evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Per-decision timestamped quotes, quote age, notional, route, liquidity, sellability and 1x/2x price-impact measurements.
EVM receipts and wallet deltas including effective gas, builder/priority payments, reverts, timeouts, replacements and fee-settlement costs.
Solana confirmed transaction metadata including base fee, compute units, priority/Jito tip, platform fee, rent paid/reclaimed and wallet/token deltas.
All attempted and abstained opportunities, preventing survivorship bias.
Explicit STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE versus UNKNOWN attribution for every cost-bearing outcome.
Out-of-sample, time-ordered money-weighted NET P&L, drawdown, profit factor, calibration error and failure rate by chain, strategy, route, size and cost regime.
Evidence of exit sellability and realised liquidation proceeds for open-position strategies.

Promotion requires fresh independent runtime evidence showing positive lower-bound money-weighted NET P&L after all costs, adequate sample size, acceptable drawdown, reconciled accounting and stable execution-failure rates.

proposals.downside_risk: Sparse or heterogeneous routes may become dormant; strict comparability rules may reduce sample size.

evidence.detail: Proven observations are identified, but avg_net is calculated only from positive proven outcomes at lines 33-34.
Replicability is increased by the number of positive observations without an equivalent penalty for proven losses.
Learned-route eligibility consumes the stored positive avg_net_base as historical net-edge evidence.

proposals.expected_effect: Fewer false-positive learned-route candidates and selection based on total capital-weighted NET P&L rather than win-only averages.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 attributed opportunities, 30 simulated executable attempts, 20 resolved outcomes, three independent market regimes, and at least 14 days per chain/route cohort.
proposals.rationale: Excluding losing observations creates survivorship bias and can label a route historically positive even when its money-weighted net result is negative. Compute route statistics over every comparable proven outcome, including failed paid-gas attempts where attribution is possible, and retain separate strategy-market and execution-infrastructure loss totals.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay time-ordered route observations using only information available before each decision. Debit realised gas, builder payments, slippage and failed-execution costs. Compare current selection with an all-outcome money-weighted selector. Stop and reject if the challenger has non-positive out-of-sample net P&L, worse net P&L drawdown, or insufficient outcome attribution.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote-rate limits and conservative round-trip assumptions may reject most signals; quote-only results may still overstate realised execution quality.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events deliberately receive zero gross edge, fees, slippage, impact, liquidity and sellability, with outcome_available=false.
Shadow P&L defaults use fixed entry and exit fee estimates rather than contemporaneous priority-fee and congestion measurements.
The execution architecture already exposes priority-tip, platform-fee, rent and fee-cap concepts that a no-broadcast shadow adapter could measure.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces falsifiable Solana opportunity economics while continuing to abstain whenever executable net edge is not positive.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 signals across 30 mints, 50 fully resolved shadow round trips, 14 days, and coverage of both normal and congested fee periods.
proposals.rationale: Leader profitability and a fresh BUY signal do not establish follower edge. Solana requires a contemporaneous round-trip quote at proposed size, price-impact and sellability checks, priority/Jito/platform costs, latency reserve, failure-cost expectation, and separate refundable rent exposure.
proposals.shadow_test: At each eligible leader signal, record timestamped entry and immediate sell quotes at actual proposed size and at 2x size. Subtract AMM/platform fees, measured impact, slippage deterioration, current priority/Jito fees, expected failure cost and non-refunded rent. Resolve against later no-lookahead exit quotes. Stop if fields are missing, sellability fails, quote age exceeds the chain-specific threshold, or net edge after every cost is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Regime-conditioned thresholds can overfit and suppress valid trades when samples are small.

evidence.detail: Common eligibility uses fixed 3-6 bps net thresholds and fixed quote-age thresholds across both chain types.
Net edge subtracts stated fees, slippage, impact and latency, but has no empirically calibrated execution-failure or adverse-selection reserve.
EVM candidates receive wallet-specific simulation and receipt-confirmed realised accounting, providing data from which calibration errors can be measured.

proposals.expected_effect: Better abstention during expensive or unreliable execution conditions and reduced acceptance of small nominal edges that cannot survive estimation error.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 500 quote decisions and 100 resolved executable simulations per chain, including at least 30 failures or rejected executions and 30 days of walk-forward observations.
proposals.rationale: Identical bps floors are not economically equivalent across EVM gas markets and Solana priority-fee/congestion states. Promotion thresholds should be based on conservative lower-bound expected value and absolute retained net profit after chain-specific failure costs, not a universal bps cutoff.
proposals.shadow_test: For each chain and cost regime, compare predicted net edge with resolved net outcome including all paid costs and failed attempts. Build a pre-decision lower confidence bound. Reject the calibration if any promoted bucket has non-positive money-weighted net P&L, systematic cost underestimation, or unstable bounds under walk-forward validation.

proposals.downside_risk: Ambiguous events may be misclassified unless an UNKNOWN category is retained and reconciled later.

evidence.detail: Solana reporting aggregates realised wins and losses but does not explicitly classify each loss as STRATEGY/MARKET or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE.
EVM execution exceptions are recorded under the generic REJECTED status, including cases where a transaction was already broadcast or paid gas.
Runtime forensics are missing, so no recent failure-rate, landed-fault or realised cost attribution can be validated.

proposals.expected_effect: Clear diagnosis of whether negative money-weighted P&L requires strategy abstention or execution remediation, with total economics remaining fully costed.
proposals.minimum_observation: A fresh continuous 14-day window with at least 50 resolved trades or cost-bearing attempts per active chain and 99% monetary reconciliation coverage.
proposals.rationale: A losing completed position is strategy/market loss when execution behaved as specified; reverts, timeouts, stale quotes, RPC faults, sell failures and paid-gas failures are execution/infrastructure failures. Keeping both ledgers separate prevents strategy changes from masking operational defects while still charging every cost to total NET P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: Generate a read-only scorecard joining decisions, simulations, broadcasts, receipts, balance deltas and exits. Require every capital or fee delta to reconcile into STRATEGY_MARKET, EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE or UNKNOWN. Stop if reconciliation differs from wallet-level deltas beyond a documented tolerance or UNKNOWN exceeds 5% of cost-bearing events.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any existing strategy to CANARY or LIVE.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime evidence is unavailable and no durable realised money-weighted NET P&L can be established.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax edge, liquidity, sellability, simulation or quote-age gates.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades do not improve the objective without positive executable edge and would increase paid failure and adverse-selection exposure.

rejected_ideas.idea: Select Solana leaders primarily by win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores payoff magnitude and costs; leader and follower executions also have different latency, impact and fee economics.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat quote or simulation profitability as realised profitability.
rejected_ideas.reason: Quotes cannot establish landing probability, realised slippage, post-trade sellability, contention costs or exit execution.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. EVM execution has fresh wallet-specific simulation, conservative gas reservation, exact pre-broadcast eth_call and receipt-based accounting. Solana Strategy Lab correctly fails closed because it lacks contemporaneous executable edge. However, learned EVM route statistics exclude proven losses, Solana shadow economics lack current quote-cost features, and runtime forensics do not provide a unified money-weighted attribution of STRATEGY/MARKET losses versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is supported.
